statements.text: Tuberculosis is a communicable disease because a pathogen causes it and it can spread.
Tuberculosis is non-communicable because it lasts a long time in some patients.
A disease can be communicable even if it continues for months.

stem:
Siddharth's classmate has tuberculosis. The school nurse says it is caused by bacteria and can spread from person to person through coughs. The class sorts diseases as communicable, non-communicable, or chronic.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Tuberculosis is caused by bacteria and spreads, so it is communicable (1). Duration alone does not make it non-communicable (2 false). Communicable diseases may still last months (3).
